args.title: Add S3_ENDPOINT instructions for MinIO to README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

Add instructions to the README.md under the Running locally section explaining how to configure S3_ENDPOINT (e.g., S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000) when running a local MinIO container, preventing uploads from incorrectly hitting AWS S3.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md currently lacks instructions for setting S3_ENDPOINT when using a local MinIO container, which causes uploads to mistakenly target AWS S3. Adding documentation under the running locally section to configure S3_ENDPOINT (e.g. S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000) will resolve this confusion.
